description: Vanilla dense-FFN baseline, 16k steps, GPT-2-scale (6L, d=384, untied, 35.79M). The paper's 1.20144 zero-line (section 3). Re-scored under the FIXED validation protocol (see ../../FIXED_EVAL.md): batch size 48 x 100 eval steps, leading 12 rows skipped, batch-size-INDEPENDENT, on the held-out val shard (shard_06542.parquet) from token 0. Rebuilt from config.json (ffn_type=dense) and loaded from checkpoint.pt with 0 missing / 0 unexpected keys.
note: The corrected bpb (1.16515) is ~0.036 below the originally reported 1.20144. This is NOT a quality change in the model; it is the deeper/cleaner eval window. The original number was scored at bs48 x eval_steps 10 (first ~245,760 val tokens); the corrected protocol scores bs48 x 100 with the anomalously-easy leading 12 rows dropped (~2.45M val tokens), which lands lower and is the batch-size-independent number every other run is now compared against. This is the matched 16k vanilla anchor for the corrected runs_corrected/ scores (e.g. exp_n_0136 naive LUT = 1.19293, +0.0278 vs this).
